Name: Basic Coop Incubator
Author: tigerchatoyance
Description:
Does what it says on the tin, adds an incubator in the basic coop. Hatch your egglings immediately without having to upgrade!

[b][color=#6aa84f]Compatible:[/color][/b]
[b]Vanilla obviously
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28462]Immersive Barns and Coops [/url][/b]-Separate file is available.

[b][color=#cc0000]Incompatible:[/color][/b]
[b]Warm Stalls and Cozy Boxes[/b] -Sorry I bubbled my brain trying to figure it out and I couldn't make it work.
[b]Probably other untested mods that heavily edit coop interiors?[/b]

[color=#1e84cc][b]Recommended:[/b][/color]
[color=#1e84cc][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's Move It [/url][/b][/color]-So you can move the incubator if you don't like its placement.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]Frequently Anticipated Questions[/b]
[i]Can I add this to an existing game? [/i]Yes but it won't install an incubator in an already-existing coop. Fresh coops only.

[i]Does this add an incubator to the Meadowlands coop? [/i]Yeah but same rules as above, enable this mod first before starting a Meadowlands farm.

[i]Does the Big Coop still come with an incubator? [/i]Yeah, you end up with 2 incubators.

[i]Can you add compatibility for XYZ? [/i]I am really kinda meh about adding more compatibility honestly. Dx I tried the two big ones then got tired.

[i]I installed the mod and something isn't working right? [/i]My testing process is as autistic as I am so if something is acting funky, please let me know.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
